description: Judicial Service Commission Secretariat - The Scheduled Public Officer's Service Minute - Amendment No. 01
reasoning: This gazette content involves amendments to the Scheduled Public Officers' Service Minute ordered by the Judicial Service Commission, specifically addressing educational qualifications and experience requirements for court stenographer and typist positions.
